etymology.root: French lieu (place) + dit (said, called) — 'the place they call'

text.what: A named place on the cadastral map — the official French term for a piece of ground people call something. Every climat is a lieu-dit; not every lieu-dit carries a cru rank.

kin.as: Burgundy's own word for the ranked version.
What a lieu-dit is called when one owner holds it all.
